names.goal-sip: Goal SIP: how much to invest
names.income-tax: Income tax: old vs new regime

labels.extraInterestForLongerTenure: Extra interest for the longer tenure

explain.sip: Each monthly instalment compounds at the expected return for the months it stays invested. The formula is FV = P × [((1 + i)^n − 1) ÷ i] × (1 + i), where i is the monthly rate and n the number of months.
explain.lumpsum: The amount grows at the expected return, compounded yearly: FV = P × (1 + r)^n.
explain.emi: EMI = P × i × (1 + i)^n ÷ [(1 + i)^n − 1], where P is the loan, i the monthly rate and n the number of months. Early EMIs are mostly interest; the share of principal rises over time.
explain.fd: Banks compound term deposits quarterly: maturity = P × (1 + r ÷ 4)^(4 × years).
explain.goal: Today's cost is inflated to the target date, existing savings and SIPs are grown at the expected return, and the monthly SIP closes the remaining gap.
explain.retirementCorpus: Expenses are inflated to retirement, then the corpus is the present value of an inflation-indexed annuity from retirement to life expectancy at the post-retirement return.
explain.incomeTax: Both regimes are computed on the same income: standard deduction, slab tax, section 87A rebate, surcharge and 4% cess. Deductions under 80C, 80D, 80CCD(1B) and 24(b) apply only in the old regime.
explain.termCover: Needs-based: the present value of replacing income (growing with inflation) until retirement, plus loans and goals, minus liquid assets and existing cover.
explain.default: Standard time-value-of-money formulas with the inputs and assumptions shown. Every result records the rule-pack version used.

legal.privacyBody:
My Money & Me is built and run by one person in India. This notice says what we collect, why, where it lives and how you control it. It applies to the public site, the weekly digest and member accounts.

## On the public site
- You can read every article, chapter and calculator without an account.
- Calculator inputs and quick check-up answers are kept in your own browser so they are there when you come back. The quick check-up sends your answers to our server once to compute the score; they are not stored.
- We run no advertising, no third-party trackers and, at present, no analytics script at all. The optional "anonymous usage analytics" choice in your account settings takes effect only if we add such a tool, and it would never carry financial figures.
- Our hosting provider keeps standard web-server logs (IP address, page requested, time) for security for a short period, as every host does.
- Cookies: one that remembers your language and, once you sign in, one that holds your session. Nothing else.

## The weekly digest
- We store only your email address, after you confirm it by clicking the link we send (double opt-in).
- Every digest has an unsubscribe link. Unsubscribing removes your address.

## Member accounts
What we store, and only because the check-up needs it:
- Sign-in details: name, email, a hash of your password (we never see the password itself) and, if you add one, the public half of a passkey.
- Profile answers you choose to give: date of birth, gender, marital status, city and state, city tier, employment type, retirement age and the two yes-or-no health questions.
- Household members and your financial items: income, expenses, assets, investments, loans and insurance policies. Financial items are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM; the key is held outside the database.
- Check-up results and history, plan progress, goals, and your consent choices with the date of each decision.
- Sessions: device type, the approximate IP address (the last part is removed before storage) and sign-in time, so you can see where you are signed in and end any session.

Why we hold it: to compute your financial health score and plan, and for nothing else. The legal basis is your consent at sign-up and the service you asked for. We do not sell data, share it with anyone, use it for advertising or profile you for third parties.

Where it lives: on our hosting provider's servers (Hostinger), in a single database for this site. Emails are sent from our own mailbox.

## How long, and how to delete
- Data stays while your account exists. Sessions end after 30 minutes idle or 30 days at most.
- You can delete your account from Settings, Privacy and data. We email a confirmation link; once you click it the account is locked and permanently erased after 30 days. Signing in during those 30 days cancels the deletion.
- If the member app is ever withdrawn, you will have at least 30 days' notice and an export.

## Your rights
- Download everything we hold about you as JSON, or your financial items as CSV, at any time from Settings.
- Correct any detail in the app, withdraw a consent from Settings, or delete the account as above.
- Raise a concern with our grievance officer (see the Grievance officer page). If you are not satisfied, you may approach the Data Protection Board of India under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

## Children
Accounts are for adults. A child appears only as a household member added by a parent, with a name and age and no contact details.

## Emails we send
Verification, password reset and deletion confirmation emails are part of running an account. The monthly plan reminder and the weekly digest are sent only if you opted in, and each one has a link to stop them.

## Changes
When this notice changes we update the date at the top. Material changes to what we collect are announced on the site before they take effect.
legal.termsBody:
These are the terms for using mymoneyandme.in. By using the site or creating an account you agree to them.

## What the site is
- My Money & Me is free educational content and tools about personal finance in India.
- Nothing here is investment, insurance, tax or legal advice, and nothing is a recommendation to buy or sell any product. The Disclaimer page says more. Decisions you take, and their outcomes, are yours.
- Calculators, the check-up and the plan use the assumptions shown and the India rule pack version named on each result. They can be wrong, out of date or not fit your situation.

## Accounts
- Accounts are for people aged 18 or over. One account per person.
- Keep your password and passkeys to yourself. You are responsible for what happens under your sign-in until you tell us it was compromised.
- Give accurate details. The score is only as good as the numbers you enter.
- We may suspend or close an account used to attack the service, scrape content, impersonate someone or break the law. Where we can, we tell you by email first.
- You can close your account at any time from Settings; see the Privacy notice for how deletion works.

## Content and copying
- Articles, chapters and calculator explanations are original. You may quote or share them with attribution and a link back.
- Do not copy the site at scale, republish whole pages, or present our tools as advice from you or anyone else.

## Availability
- The site is provided as is. We aim for it to be up and correct, but we promise neither.
- Features may change or be withdrawn. If the member app is withdrawn you will get at least 30 days' notice and a way to export your data.

## Liability
To the extent Indian law allows, My Money & Me is not liable for any loss arising from use of the site, its content or its tools.

## Law
These terms are governed by the laws of India.

## Contact
hello@mymoneyandme.in
legal.grievanceBody:
This page is published under the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021 and the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

## Grievance officer
The site is run by its founder, who also acts as grievance officer.

- Email: hello@mymoneyandme.in with the subject "Grievance"
- Or write from the email address on your account, so we can verify it is you.

## What to include
- What happened, the page or feature involved, and when.
- What you would like us to do (correct, delete, explain, stop an email).

## Timelines
- We acknowledge within 48 hours.
- We resolve within 30 days, and sooner where the law requires a shorter period.
- Requests to delete personal data follow the 30-day process in the Privacy notice.

## If you are not satisfied
For matters under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 you may approach the Data Protection Board of India once it is constituted and taking complaints.
legal.accessibilityBody:
We want every person to be able to learn money here, in their own language, with whatever device or assistive technology they use.

## Standard
We aim for WCAG 2.1 level AA across the site in every language it ships in.

## What we have done
- Keyboard-operable calculators, sliders paired with typed inputs, visible focus styles, a skip-to-content link, one heading hierarchy per page, and a minimum body text size of 16 px.
- Every page declares its language so screen readers switch voice between English and Tamil.
- Last check: 25 October 2026, an automated WCAG 2.1 A and AA scan of 16 page types in both languages plus a manual keyboard pass. No automated violations were found.

## Known gaps
- Quiz feedback uses colour (green and red) with no icon yet.
- Calculator charts are drawn as SVG without a text summary; the year-by-year table under each chart holds the same figures.
- Some inline links inside chapter text are smaller than the 24 px target size on phones.
- The Tamil typeface is not yet shipped as a web font, so rendering depends on the device.

We are working through these. High-contrast and dyslexia-friendly modes are planned.

## Tell us
If something does not work for you, email hello@mymoneyandme.in with the page and what happened. We reply within five working days.

about.title: About My Money & Me
about.intro: A free place to learn money, check your financial health and leave with a plan. Built in India, for India, in English and Tamil.
about.body:
## Why it exists
Financial education in India is mostly sold, not taught. Most explanations end in a product pitch, and the honest ones assume you already know the words. My Money & Me starts from first principles, uses Indian numbers and rules, and never recommends a fund, bank or insurer.

## What is here
- Articles on everyday money questions, in plain language.
- A learning hub with three tracks: adults, kids, and women. Each chapter is short, has an embedded calculator where it helps, and ends with a quiz.
- 60 calculators that all share one engine and one India rule pack, so the SIP calculator and the retirement calculator never disagree with each other.
- A financial health check-up that scores eight dimensions and turns the result into one ordered plan.

## Who runs it
One person, with help from AI tools for drafting and code. Chapters and articles are written from first principles and reviewed before publishing. Tamil versions drafted with AI are labelled until a person has reviewed them.

## How it is funded
By voluntary donations and nothing else. There are no ads, no affiliate links and no sponsored content. We do not sell data or financial products.

## How the numbers stay honest
Tax slabs, scheme rates, insurance norms and the scoring weights live in a versioned India rule pack. Every calculator result and check-up names the version it used, so you can tell when something was last updated.

## What is next
More chapters in every track, more Indian languages, and a better member app. The order is decided by what readers ask for.

## Contact
hello@mymoneyandme.in
